mathematical_validation.scope: Synthetic analytic scalar projections only; no native field, new PDE or biological interpretation
mathematical_validation.input_convention: Complex peak phasors with+jomega_t; one fixed real spatial projection direction

quadrature_counterexample.interpretation: Dropping phasor imaginary parts is invalid; this does not invalidate real-field paper derivations

single_carrier_control.interpretation: Zero beat-envelope variation can coexist with nonzero field RMS

same_frequency_control.interpretation: Sum outputs coherently at each frequency before computing RMS

paper_proofs.display_precision: Existing Float32 native-cell complex display samples and their conversion bounds; existing source Float64 ROI statistics retained separately
paper_proofs.directional_two_tone_formula: For fixed real unit n: a=n dot E3000, b=n dot E3030 after coherent output sum. A(t)=abs(a exp(jw1t)+b exp(jw2t)); modulation depth=max(A)-min(A)=2min(abs(a),abs(b))
paper_proofs.maximum_direction_scope: Saved2074-direction maxTIS statistics are separate; no new continuous maximum or direction search

paper_reference.title: Noninvasive Deep Brain Stimulation via Temporally Interfering Electric Fields
paper_reference.publication_read_access: Cell direct403; primary author-lab PDF read; no article/figure redistribution
paper_reference.application: Independent figures from this project data: separate carriers, analytic envelope, directional modulation maps and linecuts
paper_reference.differences: Article salineD50x10mm/isolated sources differs from fixed layeredD50x25.1mm/top electrodes/commonGND/50ohm; no activation or experimental equivalence

electric_field.bound_kind: Maximum over every stored mode/match/case/plane; phase-independent complex triangle bound plus saved RMS display/volume maxima; rounded upwards to1/2/5 decade
electric_field.scope: Instantaneous/envelope/directional bounds apply to the exported native slices; full-volume RMS maxima are separately included. No unsaved spatial field is claimed.

current_density.scope: RMS current density only; no bound on unsaved instantaneous current density is inferred

fixed_scale_contract.interpretation: Common numerical axes do not make RMS, modulation, instantaneous E or current density identical physical quantities. Labels, units and validation holds remain separate.
fixed_scale_contract.fixed_manual_zoom: No automatic or ROI-dependent zoom is defined. A future explicit manual zoom must preserve the locked full-range view and disclose clipping.

manual_range_proof.controls: Per-chart axes/colour min-max, group apply, reset and settingsJSON export/import
manual_range_proof.clipping: Out-of-display counts/marks only; underlying values and raw hover retained
manual_range_proof.waveform_time: Reconstruct the actual existing complex two-tone projection at the requested start/end times; display sampling remains bounded

original_scientific_checks.display_precision: existing Float32 native display only; saved Float64 ROI statistics unchanged
